Wildfires spread across Southern Europe, impacting Tour de France

Wildfires have intensified across southern Europe, particularly in Portugal and Greece, forcing thousands to evacuate their homes. The blazes have grown significantly, with a firefighter and a resident injured. The fires have also impacted the Tour de France cycling race, leading to the cancellation of public access to the third stage.
